source.title: Susan B. Anthony Dollar Mintage - Coin Mintages
source.citesItsOwnSource: SusanBAnthonyDollar.org (https://susanbanthonydollar.org/susan-b-anthony-dollar-mintages/), which shows the same figures

licence: Mintage figures are facts, not copyrightable expression (docs/catalog-data-licensing.md section 1, Feist). This is NOT a US Mint publication, so the section 3 public-domain note does not apply; only nine numbers are taken, no text or table layout.
whyNotTheMint: The US Mint Director's annual reports on FRASER count coins by fiscal year (ending 30 September), not by the date on the coin. The FY 1982 report's Table 2 lists $1 coins made in FY 1982 (Philadelphia 1,200,000, Denver 250,000), after the last 1981-dated coin, so fiscal-year totals can't be mapped to dates. The FY 1979 and FY 1980 PDFs did not load and the FY 1981 PDF has no machine-readable text (https://fraser.stlouisfed.org/files/docs/publications/usmint/).
disagreement: A PCGS article gives 2,908,145 for each of the 1981-P, 1981-D and 1981-S (https://www.pcgs.com/news/Looking-Back-At-Susan-B-Anthony-Dollars, seen in a search excerpt; the page itself did not load). This file uses the coinmintages.com figures.
crossCheck: The same source gives 1999-P 29,592,000 and 1999-D 11,776,000, matching the two 1999 coins already in us-dollars-susan-b-anthony.json (from Wikipedia).
scope: Business strikes only. Proofs listed by the source (1979-S, 1980-S, 1981-S) are left out. The 1979-P Wide Rim / Narrow Rim varieties have no separate figure and are not added.
